reasons.c.integration: The __grpc_c arms run the Rust integration harness, whose backend factory, backend pool and macros changed.
reasons.dotnet.grpc: The __grpc_dotnet arms run the Rust integration harness, whose backend factory, backend pool and macros changed.
reasons.python.grpc: The __grpc_python arms run the Rust integration harness, whose backend factory, backend pool and macros changed.
reasons.rust.chaos: chaos/config.rs and chaos/workload.rs add the javascript backend and their unit tests, and the crate includes the changed rust/tests/common.
reasons.rust.integration: The shared test support in rust/tests/common (backend factory, backend pool, the multilanguage macros that now add a __grpc_js arm) changed, and producer_test.rs gains new scenarios.
reasons.rust.integrity: The integrity crate includes the changed shared test support in rust/tests/common.
reasons.rust.performance: The performance crate includes the changed shared test support in rust/tests/common.
reasons.rust.xtask: The xtask package changes in bump_version, java, javadoc, config_types, config_consts, error_hierarchy and lint_custom (with updated tests), and gains the java_index_json and javascript_gen modules.
